what: When the pointer hovers a button, the button shifts 5px down-left (.3s power2.out), the text line slides up 100% and disappears (.1s), and the same text rises in from 100% below after a .05s delay (.1s). Moving the mouse inside the button drags it, delayed .6s (power3.out), by the distance from the button center to the cursor within ±10px horizontally and vertically each, on release the text line plays in reverse and the button returns to place over .6s — tape-piece-like header buttons (Menu · Contact)

options.x · y: Distance pushed on interaction (px), default -5 · 5 — 0 means no push
options.swap: Duration of the line change (sec), default .1 — links use .15 too
options.lag: Gap before the trailing text line arrives (s), default .05
options.pull: Max pull distance (px), default 10 — 0 means no pull, only push and text lines
options.follow: Duration of the pull away and return (sec), default .6
options.ease: Push and text-line curve, default power2.out
options.[data-fx-part=glitch]: 1em-high window holding two text lines — same text in data-text (sets the width)
options.[data-fx-part=top] · [data-fx-part=bot]: Current text line · same text line rising from below (if none, only push and drag)

note: The original applies this only at widths of 992px and up — on touch screens (hover false) nothing is attached.
